d: Long, wavy raven-black hair with blunt bangs frames a youthful, mature face with large, shimmering violet eyes and a soft expression. The build is slender with a prominent chest, dressed in a form-fitting black sleeveless top under a deep blue hooded cloak adorned with gold crescent moon and star patterns. A blue fingerless glove covers one hand, which holds a glowing pink crystal orb entwined by a golden serpent.
